main.description: The ballot a token was spent on: how a voter checks that theirs is on the board and says what they said. It works where the counts are hidden too, since knowing a token is having cast it. Like `castBallot` it takes no session and reads none: asked as nobody, it does not pair a voter with their token.

token.description: base64url without padding, as it was cast.

receipt.description: Signed again for whoever asks: the answer to their cast, which carried the first, may never have reached them.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such poll, or no ballot spent that token.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: Not a secret poll, or a token that is not base64url.
